name: Aridagawa (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Aridagawa town emblem in white: a disc crossed by green curved lines, like a stylised river.
history: Municipal flag of Aridagawa, a town in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 13 June 2006.

features.role: Aridagawa town emblem — a disc crossed by green curved lines, like a stylised river
